cohort.future_reserve_policy: indices32..63 are path/hash sealed only; zero model/environment execution until a later independently preregistered confirmation is authorized
cohort.qualification_rule: On every one of the 32 fixed candidates, the exact model first emits an explicit plan and then acts uninterrupted with that plan retained. Qualified iff plan block content <=96 model tokens, no reasoning/<think> trace is present, trajectory succeeds within <=12 environment actions, and a preregistered interruption has >=2 completed and >=2 remaining nontrivial environment actions. No replacement; if <16 qualified -> INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_NATURAL_TRAJECTORIES. All qualified candidates enter sanity denominators regardless of residual outcome.

frozen_sanity_gate.failure_interpretation: matched non-plan/position controls explain the replay residual or content identity is not stable enough; kill ReplayResidual before causal injection search
frozen_sanity_gate.pass_interpretation: representation sanity only; permits a separately preregistered bounded causal discovery but is NOT evidence of causal plan restoration/persistence
requirements: at least 70% of qualified families have family_aggregate_margin > 0
median same-plan temporal cosine exceeds median ALT_NEUTRAL_POSITION cosine by >=0.10
median across-layer same-family retrieval top1 accuracy >=0.25

leakage_and_phase_guards: no partial outcome inspection to change protocol

natural_plan_protocol.executor: same model, plan retained in visible history; deterministic action generation constrained to current admissible commands
natural_plan_protocol.padding: deterministic tokenizer-audited neutral filler to exactly 128 tokens in every replay condition; fail closed if exact length cannot be constructed
natural_plan_protocol.planner_output: explicit ordered <PLAN>...</PLAN> block, no hidden/expert plan fields and no chain-of-thought
natural_plan_protocol.reasoning_trace_guard: enable_thinking=False; reject qualification if <think> or equivalent reasoning trace appears; stripped replay must contain no prior reasoning trace
natural_plan_protocol.trajectory_source: model own uninterrupted successful trajectory; never expert/oracle actions

next_if_fail: refute this descendant; do not rescue using threshold relaxation, family selection, nearby filler/control variants, or synthetic reciprocal source prompts
next_if_pass: freeze selected causal-discovery protocol in a new WorkItem with independent review; bounded layer/site/scale grid may be prospectively specified there but may not use sealed reserve outcomes

novelty_boundary.NPM: activation-space procedural steering is prior art and repeatedly injected; future ReplayResidual claim requires episode-specific within-trajectory residual + single reset-time injection + multi-step persistence
novelty_boundary.Plans_Dont_Persist: replay pairing itself is prior art diagnostic; novelty is not claimed here

primary_metrics.family_aggregate_margin: median across the four frozen layers; no layer selection
primary_metrics.retrieval_secondary: for each frozen layer, query r_PLAN_i(t1) against all r_PLAN_j(t2); same-family top1 accuracy, leave-all-families-in, no training

replay_conditions.ALT_NEUTRAL_POSITION: independent neutral filler vocabulary/seed, exact128 tokens, same slot and positions
replay_conditions.GENERIC_HISTORY: deterministic transcript-derived non-plan facts from already-visible pre-anchor observations/actions + neutral padding, exact128 tokens
replay_conditions.PLAN_PRESENT: original model-generated plan content + neutral padding to exact128 tokens
replay_conditions.SHUFFLED_PLAN: same plan step clauses under deterministic SHA256 permutation + neutral padding, exact128 tokens
replay_conditions.UNRELATED_PLAN: deterministic different-family plan from within the fixed qualified set, selected by predeclared cyclic SHA256 order; content max96 then neutral padding to exact128; no outcome matching

anchors.t1: after first completed post-plan action-observation cycle
anchors.t2: after second completed post-plan action-observation cycle; must precede the frozen interruption/reset point

replay_pairing.capture_token: last token immediately before the next ACTION: field at each anchor
replay_pairing.invariant: teacher-force the exact same realized action-observation trajectory in every replay arm; only the fixed 128-token plan block differs
replay_pairing.normalization: retain raw FP32 residual for norm statistics; use L2-unit residual only for cosine/selectivity metrics; norm<=1e-8 maps to zero vector and is a failure for positive-selectivity family, never excluded
replay_pairing.site: residual stream output of frozen transformer block
